places.name: Synthetic demo data
places.how: Made up places for the mock neighborhood. Times are from distance on a route 1.3 times the straight line: 3 mph walking; driving adds 1.5 minutes to get going, at 20 mph (Estimate).

value.name: Synthetic demo data
value.how: Price per square foot against homes of the same type nearby that are for sale now or sold in the last year.

rentVsBuy.name: Synthetic demo data
rentVsBuy.how: Median asking rent of floor plans with the same bedroom count in apartment communities within 2 km.

cost.name: FRED, county tax data, Insurance Information Institute, EIA, listing HOA
cost.how: Estimate. 30 year fixed loan at the Freddie Mac average rate (6.9%, week of 2026-11-14), plus property tax, the state average insurance premium, HOA and the electric estimate. Mortgage insurance for small down payments is not included.

insurance.name: Insurance Information Institute (NAIC data)
insurance.how: Estimate. The state average homeowners premium, not a quote. The pressure label comes from FEMA's risk rating for the census tract and the flood zone.

energy.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
energy.how: Estimate. The state's average household electricity use (700 kWh a month, mock) scaled by this home's floor area against an 1,800 sq ft home (limited to between half and double), times the state's average residential price.

solar.name: Synthetic demo data
solar.how: Estimate. 60% of the roof area seen from the air is treated as usable for 400 W panels. Yearly output is from NREL PVWatts for this location, reduced for tree cover. Savings count only power the home would use itself.

risk.name: Synthetic demo data
risk.how: The risk index compares this census tract with every tract in the country. The flood zone is the mapped zone at the home's location.

census.name: Synthetic demo data
census.how: Values for the census tract the home is in, next to the same value for the whole city.

activity.name: Synthetic demo data
activity.how: Commercial buildings, current tenants and sales within 1.5 km, and shops and places to eat within a 10 minute walk (800 m).

aerial.name: Synthetic demo data
aerial.how: Read from the aerial image: roof, pool, solar panels and tree cover. Roof condition is Vexcel's 1 to 5 rating (5 is best).

noise.name: Synthetic demo data
noise.how: Straight line distance to the nearest highway, rail line and airport.

home.name: Synthetic demo data
home.how: Taken from the listing's own feature text.

scores.name: Grand Property Auto
scores.how: Each score is 0 to 100 from the facts on its card. The formulas are in docs/SCORES.md.
